report.summary: Google (Petrovic et al., 2021) on 55M LOC: 18% killed, 73% unproductive/equiv; after filtering, mutation score ~39%. Equivalent mutants reduced via MutantEQ (constraint-based) and TCE (compiler). Facebook's SapFix evaluated patches with ~50% kill rate. Industry limits operators (statement deletion, condition flip) due to cost, high equivalence (40-50%), and diminishing returns.

handoff.suggestion: Adopt a minimal operator set (statement deletion, condition negation, arithmetic) with compiler-based equivalence detection (TCE). Target a 30–40% mutation score and integrate into CI for changed files only.
